subject: 68cc04ec9e8dfa8163c0c559
question: Two identical insulated metal spheres A and B carry charges $+q$ and $-3q$, respectively. They are brought in contact and then separated. Determine the charge on each sphere after separation. Give reason.

options.A: +q, −3q — Charge cannot move between identical conductors.
options.B: −q, −q — Total charge (−2q) is conserved and, for identical spheres, contact makes them equipotential, so the charge divides equally.
options.C: −2q, 0 — Charge flows until the more negative sphere becomes neutral.
options.D: +2q, −2q — Equal and opposite charges must remain after contact.
